entries.subject: DAMIT 5820: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-5820.txt. Model 5820, version 2019-10-23, pole (263°, -47°), period 5.93333 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: The retained calibration uses 44.749 ±0.37 km. effective body diameter

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The Shape view uses the shared normal grid because the source release provides no registered surface imagery. The grid is a coordinate guide, not regolith, measured albedo or an optical photograph.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Other DAMIT shape solutions
entries.finding: The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 5821: pole (127°, -62°), 5.93334 h, version 2019-10-23. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent shape, spin or scale evidence distinguishes these alternatives, or a changed release offers a demonstrably better supported model.
